D: A celebrity chef reconnects with her childhood best friend when she comes home to San Francisco.
P: Serve the mains when Judy shows young Sasha how to make kimchi stew.
S: Rice cups with soy beef, spinach, carrot, fried egg and gochujang
Rice topped with sautéed spinach, carrot and beef mince cooked in soy and garlic, a fried egg and gochujang.
Twice-fried wings tossed in a sticky gochujang and honey glaze
Chicken wings fried twice until crackly, tossed in a sticky glaze of gochujang, honey and garlic, scattered with sesame.
Tiny tasting menu salmon cucumber cups
hollowed rounds with yuzu crème fraîche, cured fish, roe and one chive, for the Keanu dinner

Thick cucumber rounds hollowed into cups, filled with yuzu crème fraîche and cured salmon, finished with salmon roe and a single chive. Cut 2 continental cucumbers into 2cm thick rounds and scoop a hollow from each with a melon baller, leaving a base. Mix 100g crème fraîche with 1 tsp yuzu or lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Dice 150g smoked salmon finely. Spoon or pipe the cream into each cup, top with salmon, a few beads of salmon roe (40g total) and a short piece of chive. Serve on a long plate, deliberately small.
M: Spicy stew of pork belly and kimchi with gochugaru, simmered until rich
Pork belly and kimchi simmered with gochugaru, garlic and stock, tofu and spring onion added at the end, served with rice.
fillets roasted under a sticky miso honey glaze, pickled cucumber, edamame and chilli mayo

Salmon roasted under a sticky white miso and honey glaze, over sushi rice with quick pickled cucumber, edamame, nori strips and chilli mayo. Rinse and cook 2 cups sushi rice, then season with 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar and salt. Mix 3 tbsp white miso, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp mirin and 1 tsp soy. Heat the oven to 200C. Brush over 4 salmon fillets and roast 12 minutes. Slice 1 cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar. Boil 200g frozen edamame 3 minutes. Build bowls with rice, salmon, cucumber, edamame, sliced nori and mayo mixed with chilli sauce.
W: Thin pancakes filled with sweet red bean paste and folded
Small pancakes of flour, egg and milk cooked in butter, filled with sweet red bean paste, folded and pan-fried until golden.
K: Roasted barley steeped in hot water, served hot or over ice
Roasted barley tea steeped in hot water for 10 minutes, served hot in small cups or chilled and poured over ice.

s.note: Rice cups with soy beef, spinach, carrot, fried egg and gochujang
s.how: Cook beef mince with soy and garlic. Saute spinach and julienned carrot separately. Spoon jasmine rice into small bowls, arrange the beef and vegetables on top and add a fried egg and a dot of gochujang. Mix it all up before eating.

s.note: Twice-fried wings tossed in a sticky gochujang and honey glaze
s.how: Fry 1kg chicken wings at 160C for 10 minutes, rest, then fry again at 190C until crackly. Warm 3 tbsp gochujang with 3 tbsp honey and crushed garlic until glossy. Toss the wings through and scatter with sesame seeds.

m.note: Spicy stew of pork belly and kimchi with gochugaru, simmered until rich
m.how: Fry 400g sliced pork belly until browned, then add 300g chopped kimchi, crushed garlic and a spoon of gochugaru. Pour in 750ml water and simmer 20 minutes. Add sliced firm tofu and spring onion for the last 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

w.note: Thin pancakes filled with sweet red bean paste and folded
w.how: Whisk 150g flour, an egg and 250ml milk into a smooth batter. Cook small thin pancakes in butter. Spoon a little red bean paste into each, fold over and press. Fry again in butter until golden on both sides and serve warm.

d.note: Roasted barley steeped in hot water, served hot or over ice
d.how: Steep 3 tbsp roasted barley tea in 1L of just-boiled water for 10 minutes. Strain and serve hot in small cups, or cool it down and pour over ice in tall glasses. Toasty, nutty and good with spicy food.
